back: $\Phi = BA\cos\theta$ (θ between B and the normal); unit weber, Wb = T m².
$N\Phi$ — flux through the coil times the number of turns.
$\varepsilon = -N\Delta\Phi/\Delta t$ — emf equals the rate of change of flux linkage.
The induced current opposes the change in flux that causes it — the minus sign in Faraday’s law; a result of energy conservation.
Currents induced in a moving conductor oppose its motion, turning kinetic energy into internal energy.
$\varepsilon = NBA\omega\sin\omega t$; peak $NBA\omega$, greatest when flux is zero.

front: Effect of doubling a generator’s rotation frequency?
back: Output frequency doubles and the peak emf doubles.
